scope: Experimental DNG E3 selected subset: independent photographic lossless DNG, lossless JPEG conformance fixes, offline SDK export interoperability and native XPC integration.
changes: DNGVersion-selected pre-1.1 category-16 convention; no decoding fallback.
Residual categories may exceed sample precision; reconstructed samples must remain within precision after modulo-65536 arithmetic.
Reject out-of-precision reconstructed codes instead of silently wrapping them.
Version Experimental codec/cache identity; preserve the legacy engine.
Reproducible owned fixtures and offline SDK/XPC differential harness; raw export and reopen on both services.

independent_reference.converter_package_signature: Adobe Inc. Developer ID Installer; trusted timestamp and Apple notarization verified using native macOS services.
independent_reference.source_corpus: Three previously authorized Nikon D750 NEF files; no LibRaw conversion. Originals retained unchanged.
independent_reference.profile_origin: Embedded Adobe dual-illuminant matrices and ForwardMatrix; not a measured TrueRenderer profile.
independent_reference.sdk_build: macOS arm64 CMake build, XMP disabled. Two missing XMP guards added to a private copy of dng_jxl.cpp; TIFF/lossless JPEG/linearization/colour algorithms unmodified.

negative_evidence: Initial bundle and core regression reject SDK-accepted DNG 1.0 category-16 vector.
Initial bundle rejects SDK-accepted 12-bit predictor-4 residuals.
New corruption regression confirms that an out-of-range sample must not wrap to declared precision.

Initial differential harness stopped on four CFA-border padding warnings for each owned synthetic image; final manifest explicitly declares these, records them for input and export, and still rejects unexpected diagnostics. Photographic DNG files have no SDK warnings.

The historical verify-package-macos.py aggregator compares dist against old root-level reports and refused that mismatch; it did not qualify this increment. Fresh per-bundle XPC reports and whole-bundle hashes were used.

delivery.signature: ad hoc; codesign deep/strict verified. Not a distribution qualification.

reproduction.differential: python scripts/test-experimental-dng.py --bundle dist/TrueRenderer.app --reference <dng_validate> --manifest <private-manifest> --root <new-project-var-directory>; test environment needs numpy/tifffile

limits: Qualified only for the exercised DNG subset, not all DNG cameras, codecs, opcodes or profiles.
Adobe conversion is a lab preparation step, not autonomous NEF decoding. Direct NEF/RAF still refused without fallback.
SDK stage2 comparison proves export interoperability; it does not compare the Experimental linearization/render to SDK colour output.
No measured colour accuracy, DeltaE00, CFA white-balance qualification or calibrated TrueRenderer camera profiles.
Synthetic padding warnings do not qualify border demosaic quality.
No Windows, broad fuzzing, physical memory/pressure, p95/p99 or full OS isolation release qualification.
No R0-R4 or SF0-SF10 gate closed, no Standard/Reference assurance mode promoted.
next_increment: E7: inventory the 30 authorized D750 NEF subtypes and implement independent Nikon parsing, codec, sensor calibration, WB and explicit profile provenance; then X-T5 and D800.
